name: Is Valid
description: Confirms that a reference points to a usable object before you call functions on it, preventing crashes from null or destroyed actors. Splits execution into valid and not-valid branches. Target is Kismet System Library.

inputs.name: Object
inputs.description: The object reference to test. Connect any actor, component, or object reference that might be null or pending destruction.

outputs.name: Is Valid
outputs.description: True if the reference is non-null AND the object is not pending kill / being garbage collected. Safe to use the reference.

outputs.name: Is Not Valid
outputs.description: True when the reference is null or the object is invalid. Use this to skip, log a warning, or take a fallback path.
